caption:
Starting a summer side hustle? Read this before you spend a dollar.

The sharing economy platforms report to the ATO. That Airbnb income, that Airtasker gig — it's all going on your record. Setting up right from the first payment is so much easier than explaining it later.

Save this and tag a friend who's starting a side hustle this summer.

#ReturnPolicyAU #SideHustle #TaxTips #ABN #SummerIncome
